lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the Telluride Hospital District board meeting Wednesday, where the board is expected to act on a Two Site Model for the new facility — a decision that will shape what gets built, where, and at what scale for years to come. Mountain Village's homeowner association is also moving, voting to form a Workforce Housing Committee and act on updated policies. Meanwhile, Town Council convenes Monday for work sessions on the Comprehensive Plan, the gondola, and a proposed third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies.

notable.stake: Board may act on Two Site Model, shaping the new hospital's location and scale.
TMVOA votes to form Workforce Housing Committee and adopt updated association policies.
Council reviews Comprehensive Plan goals and a third-party audit of rental housing policy.
